reviews.text: After SCF got done with my house, it looks like it did 23 years ago when it was brand new.  Chris and Eli did a fantastic job on my exterior, deck, sidewalk and rear pavers.  They were professional, courteous and thorough.  The whole experience from initial contact to job completion was stress-free.  They are a first class operation and I highly recommend them.
Chris Hess knows his trade and performs excellent work.  He works well with his clients to find the best solutions for cleaning and restoration.  Highly recommend his services!

Chris and the team from SCF came to my home today and power washed the house, deck, and took care of our stone pavers. As always they did a phenomenal job and I would recommend them to anyone looking to beautify their home. Very professional and a job well done. Chris is dedicated to his craft and cares for your house as if it is his own.
